One of the most chilling aviation mysteries in modern-day, a Boeing 777, carrying 239 people, vanishes over the Indian Ocean; nearly a decade later, no one knows what really happened to Malaysia Flight 370.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E08 — The Rendlesham Forest Incident
An event outside a U.S. Air Force base near the Rendlesham Forest in England becomes an international legend, and one of history's strangest unidentified encounters; for more than 40 years, the question has endured.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E14 — The Assassination of RFK
Five years after John F. Kennedy is killed by gunshot, his brother Robert meets the same fate; an assassin's bullet again changes the course of history, and the latest clues in the case are riddled with inconsistencies.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E19 — Unlocking the Secrets of the Nazca Lines
They've been called the world's greatest archaeological enigma: 2,000-year-old geoglyphs made in the Peruvian desert that span over 50 miles; the drawings are so massive, they can only be seen from the air.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E02 — Titanic's Lost Evidence
A dust-covered box hidden in a British manor house for 108 years contains the personal notes of Lord Mersey, the respected British jurist and politician charged with investigating the sinking of the Titanic in 1912.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E16 — Unlocking the Secrets of Stonehenge
It's one of the most famous prehistoric monuments on Earth -- a mysterious arrangement of stones that have adorned the English countryside for millennia; nobody knows how the landmark was built or why.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E13 — The Missing Tesla Papers
Nicola Tesla had revolutionary ideas, but in the hands of the wrong people, those ideas could be used for evil purposes; when Tesla died, he allegedly had 80 trunks of papers full of ideas, but only 60 have been seen again.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E03 — Endurance: The Hunt for Shackleton's Ice Ship
A new ground-breaking expedition heads back to the frozen seas to hunt down Shackleton's lost ship.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E11 — The Search for Alexander the Great
The story of the most celebrated warrior king in history still stirs fascination more than 2000 years after his death.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E12 — The Chicago Tylenol Murders
A series of unexplained deaths near Chicago in 1982 starts a nationwide panic; the victims are connected by one frightening detail: cyanide-tainted capsules of Extra-Strength Tylenol; 40 years later, it remains an active FBI investigation.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E18 — The Lost Pirate Treasure of Jean Lafitte
Known as "The Terror of the Gulf," the whereabouts of Jean Lafitte's treasure remain unknown; the swamps and bayous were his base, and likely also his hiding place; treasure hunters have found very little of Lafitte's stash.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E06 — The Holy Grail
It's a treasure coveted by everyone from Roman emperors to Adolf Hitler; a sacred object said to hold incredible powers of healing, resurrection and immortality, the Holy Grail is the most sought-after relic in the world.

Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

A look at what could cause once-thriving groups of people to just abandon their great cities, never to return; modern scientific knowledge may be able to help answer the unsolved questions surrounding these lost civilizations.

Whether it's called intuition, clairvoyance, or extrasensory perception, this elusive "sixth sense" defies explanation; can scientists find the secret to unlocking these remarkable gifts?

Throughout human history, many cultures have used sacred rituals to express their spiritual beliefs; there are many rituals that are thought to unlock supernatural powers.

From the ancient Babylonians to modern-day urban explorers, mankind has always been fascinated by abandoned places; discovering the allure that draws people to post-apocalyptic landscapes.

The animal kingdom is full of deadly predators, and some of them attack in extraordinary and inexplicable ways; some animals strike back at humans for reasons beyond normal defense and hunger.

Probing the Windsor Hum and Old Faithful; visiting a Venezuelan lake where lightning rains down 300 nights a year; sizing up the massive underground fire that's been burning in Centralia, Pa., since 1962.

Genius is widely considered to be the ability to change the world in an incredible way, like inventing new technology, deciphering the mysteries of the universe, or creating transcendent art, but its origin is a mystery.
